title: console: a write answer's `warnings` (advisory validation hits) is shown to the user after save, on the existing write-warning channel
body:
Filing gate ①: the console half of findings A-05, B-10, C-10. Filed by the triage seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015, `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`), splitting objectstack-ai/objectstack#22722 (the maintainer's HotCRM browser pass, objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2058, measured on `@objectstack/*` 17.7.0). ⛔ Not a claim.

**Restart when:** a published `@objectstack/spec` release that objectui installs carries the `warnings` key on `CreateDataResponseSchema` / `UpdateDataResponseSchema` (objectstack-ai/objectstack#22726). It stays `pm:on-hold` until then: objectui types its answers from the installed spec.

## Read on objectui `main` `ce991bd70f`

`packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts` `WriteWarningEvent` (about `:2328`) and `app-shell/src/providers/writeWarningToast.ts` already carry `droppedFields` to a toast. `warnings` rides the same channel.

## Done when

- After a save whose answer carries `warnings`, the user sees each message, through the same toast channel `droppedFields` uses.
- The read is additive: an answer without the key shows nothing new. That also holds against a runtime that predates the key.
- Pins:
  - a warning is shown after save;
  - CONTROL: no key, no toast.

`domain:ui` · p3.
